title: What are human values, and how do we align AI to them?

bias_targets.methodology: The authors measure the ideological motivation of users by using a language model prompt to score initial chat responses on a 1 to 5 scale based on whether they echo political slogans, include strong normative judgments, or aim to persuade. They then compare these ideology scores against user survey responses to evaluate whether the Moral Graph Elicitation (MGE) process is robust against ideological rhetoric and factionalism.
